verdict.rationale: Shortcut ships Iterations, its sprint construct, for prioritizing and tracking a team's week-to-week work. It also automates sprint management by auto-creating future Iterations and rolling unfinished Stories into the next one. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of iteration planning (capacity, velocity, burndown or sprint reports) and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing and pricing pages.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development

citations.quote: Quickly prioritize and keep track of the work your team needs to be focused on week-to-week with Iterations.
